description: Round 6 REPLACES the previous test pair: 'රට'/'කතා' no longer demonstrates a genuine preference, since round 6's full human review REMOVED 'කතා' from the word bank entirely (row 33's verdict was 'Remove') -- meaning only one word ('රට') is even eligible now, collapsing this case into a duplicate of codemix_forced_single_substitution.json rather than testing preference. Re-derived against a still-valid plausible/non-plausible PAIR mined fresh from the current bank: 'පරණ' (old) is codemix_plausible=true; 'කෑල්ල' (girl/piece, slang) is an eligible word-bank entry but codemix_plausible=false. Both occur adjacent in real SOLD text. At seed=2, light draws a non-zero target_cmi=19.53 (the same draw codemix_forced_single_substitution.json uses, since the draw only depends on (severity, seed, n_words), not wordbank content), and the resulting single-unit budget must select 'පරණ' (the plausible candidate), never 'කෑල්ල' -- selection only falls back to implausible words when nothing plausible is available (see src/noisers/codemix.py's _single_word_pool 4-level priority).
